answer: A spiral token splits in two: one half stays with the sparrow, one sealed in the registry. The sparrow claims rewards by showing its half and whispering the code, matched by the auditor to the sealed half. A rented-half ring fails: a borrowed half keeps the lender's cut and never fits. A pair costs 90 plus a 70 bond, so one fake costs 160; 1,000 fakes cost 160,000 vs 40,000 rewards. A lone sparrow mints one pair, bond back after a clean epoch.
